# Branded Baristas

> Specialty coffee catering and branded coffee experiences for corporate events, brand activations and workplaces across Europe. Based in Zoetermeer, the Netherlands. Bilingual site (Dutch / English).

Company facts:
- Legal name: Branded Baristas B.V.
- Address: Albert Schweitzersingel 91, 2719 DZ Zoetermeer, Netherlands
- Email: info@branded-baristas.com
- Phone: +31 6 41697775
- Service area: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Luxembourg, France, United Kingdom
- Pricing model: fixed day rate based on concept, duration and guest count (not per cup)
- Coffee: specialty-grade beans from local and European roasters
- Founded by hospitality and barista professionals; trained baristas in house

## Core services

- [Mobile coffee bar](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/events/mobile-coffee-bar): Fully equipped mobile coffee bar for brand activations and corporate events.
- [Piaggio Ape tuk-tuk coffee bar](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/events/piaggio-tuk-tuk): Compact Piaggio Ape converted into a specialty coffee bar (approx. 300 × 150 × 200 cm).
- [Vintage coffee truck (1969 Commer)](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/events/coffee-truck): Iconic vintage truck on wheels for outdoor events.
- [Barista hire](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/events/barista-service): Hire an experienced barista for an existing coffee setup.
- [Office espresso bar](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/in-company/espresso-bar): Recurring weekly or monthly on-site espresso bar for offices.
- [Pop-up coffee moments](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/in-company/pop-up): One-off on-site coffee activations for onboardings and company days.
- [Executive coffee service](https://branded-baristas.com/en/diensten/in-company/executive): Discreet high-end coffee service for boardrooms and VIP meetings.
- [Branded coffee moments](https://branded-baristas.com/en/branding): Custom cups, latte art, bar styling and uniforms aligned to your brand.

## How to request a quote

Send structured lead details (service, event date, guest count, location, duration, concept, contact info) to the [quote form](https://branded-baristas.com/en/offerte) or email info@branded-baristas.com. Expect a reply within one business day.
